Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly show hyperdense, metallic-density material within the pulmonary arteries, which is pathognomonic for polymethylmethacrylate (cement) embolism following vertebroplasty. This finding explains the intraoperative drop in end-tidal CO2 due to acute pulmonary vascular obstruction and matches the description in option C.
